title: coryphantha sneedii var. guadalupensis
intro: Coryphantha sneedii var. guadalupensis, commonly known as Guadalupe spineless cactus, is a rare and unique variety of cactus native to the Guadalupe Mountains in Texas, USA, and Mexico. The Guadalupe spineless cactus has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which offer health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of the Guadalupe spineless cactus include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of the Guadalupe spineless cactus include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
